name: Lord of Black Flames
description:
You have taken on the form of a Black Dragon.

  • Your Size and the Range of your Melee attacks increase by +1.

  • Your Body and Soul increase by +2.

  • Your Unarmed Attacks are no longer considered Ineffective.

  • You gain a Fly speed of 5. If you already have a Fly Speed, it increases by +5.

  • Once per turn, when you would receive Wounds, you may immediately use a Black Flame ability with a cost equal or less to the number of Wounds inflicted as a Free Action. This can be used when you take Wounds to use a Black Flame ability.

This effect lasts until the end of combat, you become Incapacitated, or you are Dying. After you use this ability, you cannot use any ability with the Apex trait until you complete a Long Rest.
